body:
We made a [calendar widget demo](https://instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/calendar-widget/) ([see source code](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/0a816c684407c421acd7244fab23736b29ea0d1b/website/examples/calendar-widget/app.js)).

You should be able to achieve this behavior with the [`connectRange`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/range-input/react/#connector) connector. The main constraint being that the dates must be timestamp numbers.

**Edit**: this solution doesn't work with two attributes.
